description: This class provides static methods to parse and extract namespaces from entity identifiers, either as strings or as EntityId or NamespacedEntityId objects.

classes.name: NamespaceReader
classes.description: Final utility class providing static methods to read namespaces from entity identifiers.

methods.name: fromEntityId(EntityId)
methods.description: Extracts namespace from an EntityId object, delegating to the specific method if the entity is NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: fromEntityId(String)
methods.description: Extracts namespace from a string identifier, using the colon ':' as separator.

methods.name: fromEntityId(NamespacedEntityId)
methods.description: Returns the namespace directly from a NamespacedEntityId object.
